verdict.line: You lose if Irelia lands E (Flawless Duet) first and chains into free Q (Bladesurge) resets on you; you win if you stun her with Q (Thundering Smash) and double-cast W (Frenzied Maul) before her E is back up.

brief.thesis: This is a stun-priority matchup: Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stuns and marks, feeding free Q (Bladesurge) resets that can burst Volibear down fast, but Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) recast heal and his own Q (Thundering Smash) stun let him win any trade where her E is already spent. At 50.7% over 1,738 games with lane and solo-kill advantage to Volibear, the champion favors the player who forces the fight on cooldown timing, not raw stats.

theirWindow.when: her E (Flawless Duet) is up and ready
theirWindow.what: She'll bait a hit to build Ionian Fervor stacks, then land E for the stun and chain Q (Bladesurge) resets off the mark. Don't stand still at 825 range when her E timer looks full — back off or force her to burn it on a minion first.

yourWindow.what: Engage immediately with Q (Thundering Smash, 300 range) to stun her before she can reposition, then land W (Frenzied Maul) twice in a row — the second cast deals bonus damage and heals you — since she has no stun to punish the all-in.

start.why: The measured data has this ahead of Doran's Blade (51.3% over 1,499 games vs 49.3% over 434) and it's the clear majority pick at 69.1% — take the extra sustain and mana to spam W through early trades.

boots.why: Irelia's damage comes from autos and on-hit Q procs, not ability bursts; Steelcaps (51.1% over 1,322 games, 65.5% pick) directly blunt that over Ionian Boots.

core.why: First piece of the 60.3%-winrate path (146 games) — on-hit damage that scales your W mark and recast.
Attack speed to keep stacking The Relentless Storm passive and threaten the W double-cast faster.
Caps the highest-winrate build and boosts the healing from your W recast directly.

her Q (Bladesurge) heal is keeping her alive through your early all-ins

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking attack speed compounds with your passive and makes the W-W recast loop and follow-up autos hit harder the longer a trade runs — exactly the kind of extended fight this matchup rewards.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 72.5% and 52.1% winrate — Volibear has the solo-kill advantage here, and Ignite closes out trades she tries to heal through with Q (Bladesurge).

playing.title: Trade only after her E
playing.detail: Watch her E (Flawless Duet) cooldown (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) and only commit your Q (Thundering Smash) engage once it's down — that removes her stun-into-reset combo entirely.

playing.title: Hold the W second cast
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's recast heals you — delay it until you're already committed to the extended trade so the heal lands when you need it, not on the opener.

playing.title: Don't swing into charged W
playing.detail: Defiant Dance reduces her physical damage taken while charging (20 down to 12s cooldown); wait it out or interrupt with Q stun before she releases the hit.

playing.title: Track her Q reset uptime
playing.detail: Bladesurge (10 down to 6s cooldown) refreshes off marked or killed targets, including minions — if she's been resetting off the wave, respect that she can dash back onto you without warning.

playing.title: Zone with E for the shield
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (16s cooldown, 1200 range) slows anything it hits and shields you if you're standing in the blast — throw it to force her around it before she commits Bladesurge.

playing.title: Save R for her all-in, not as poke
playing.detail: Stormbringer's cooldown (160 down to 110s) is too long to waste early — hold it to punish a committed E+Q dive or to disable a tower if she forces a dive under it.

playing.title: Check stacks before you fight
playing.detail: Per the matchup read: check her Ionian Fervor passive stacks and whether she's running Conqueror before engaging — if she's capped out, break off rather than extend the trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — stun priority, cooldown windows, and trade sequencing — is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Check Irelia’s (P) and Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Avoid her (E) and deal damage with [Q][E] before retreating.
